Play a full game between two strategies

Source: R/play.R
gm_play.Rd

Run a self-play game from a starting position until termination, with each side driven by a strategy function.

Usage

gm_play(
  white = "engine",
  black = "engine",
  position = NULL,
  max_moves = 200L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

white, black

Strategy functions. Each takes a gm_position and returns a single move in standard algebraic notation. Defaults to the native engine at depth 2. Character shortcuts "random" and "engine" are also accepted.

position

Starting gm_position. Default is the standard start.

max_moves

Maximum full moves before adjudication. Default 200.

verbose

If TRUE (default), report each move.

Value

A gm_game object.

Details

A game ends on checkmate, stalemate, the fifty-move rule, threefold repetition, insufficient mating material, or when max_moves full moves have been played, in which case the game is adjudicated as a draw. The termination reason is recorded in the game's Termination tag.

See also

Other play: gm_simulate()

Examples

# \donttest{
gm_play(white = "random", black = "random", max_moves = 10, verbose = FALSE)
#> <gm_game> — 20 half-moves, result "1/2-1/2"
#> random vs random
#> 1. g3 d5 2. b4 Bf5 3. Na3 c5 4. Nc4 Qa5 5. Nd6+ Kd8 6. Nh3 Qb6 ...
# }
